nodes.label: Responsive Design System
nodes.rationale: The fixed 393 x 852 reference canvas must be translated into reusable tokens, responsive layout, and safe-area-aware components.

nodes.label: Major Product Risks
nodes.rationale: Backend contracts, live synchronization, coach authorization, missing screens, and incomplete business rules must be closed before final implementation decisions.

nodes.label: Mobile Non-Functional Requirements
nodes.rationale: A shared iOS and Android codebase must remain responsive, secure, accessible, observable, and resilient to network failures.

nodes.label: Feature-Oriented Frontend Architecture
nodes.rationale: Features own their API, types, schemas, hooks, screens, components, and tests while shared services and design primitives remain centralized.

nodes.label: Design System Translation
nodes.rationale: Figma absolute coordinates should become semantic tokens, Flexbox, safe areas, max widths, and dynamic text.

nodes.label: Live Match Polling Strategy
nodes.rationale: Begin with polling on visible live-match screens, suspend it in the background, and migrate to WebSocket or SSE only if freshness and scale require it.

nodes.label: Mobile Authentication Security Model
nodes.rationale: Tokens belong in OS-backed secure storage, secrets must not be logged, and backend authorization remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy Consent
API Contract Availability
nodes.rationale: The frontend uses local demo data until an API contract is available.

nodes.label: Reusable UI Components and Bottom Sheets
Mockup-Derived Dark Theme Tokens
nodes.rationale: The design system centralizes dark-theme tokens derived from the application mockup.

nodes.label: Backend Secret Bundle Safety
nodes.rationale: Backend tokens and secrets must not be stored in the application bundle.
